latest_cos_commentary.headline: Yelp for Restaurants is a reservations, waitlist, and AI phone-answering suite bundled with Yelp's consumer discovery platform, sold on a flat monthly subscription rather than per-cover fees, with customers including Snooze and Brinker International.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Adjacent to Genius's loyalty_engagement line via guest/reservation management; does not compete on core pos, payments, or back_office.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Actively expanding its AI feature set (Yelp Host AI answering) as a differentiator against traditional reservation platforms.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant mainly in reservation/waitlist and guest-discovery conversations, not core POS or payments deals.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No leadership or restaurant-segment-specific financial detail was verified; the Brinker International customer relationship's current scope is unconfirmed.

verification_needed: Financial performance specific to the restaurant/reservations segment (Yelp Inc. is public but does not break this out cleanly)
